"""RoboPaint episode controller and permanent command journal.
Only RGB/depth, robot proprioception, public kinematics and the exemplar are used.
Commands in commands/ are executed once in numbered order by this single client.
"""
import os,sys,time,json,traceback
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
ROOT=Path('/app/output'); (ROOT/'commands').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r=Robot();spec=r.spec();last=r.get_obs(cameras=['scene_cam']);target=None
count=0

def pose(): return np.array(last.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14])
def quat(angle=30):
 a=np.deg2rad(angle/2);return np.array([0,np.cos(a),np.sin(a),0])
def send(P,dt=.05,cameras=['practice_cam'],note=''):
 global last,count,target
 P=np.asarray(P);count+=1
 np.save(ROOT/f'actions_{count:04d}.npy',P)
 (ROOT/f'actions_{count:04d}.json').write_text(json.dumps({'dt':dt,'note':note,'status_before':r.status()}))
 last=r.submit('ee_pose',P,dt=dt,video='none',cameras=cameras,note=note)
 last.save(f'/app/runs/action_{count:04d}')
 target=P[-1].copy()
 print('SUBMIT',count,'now',pose().round(7).tolist(),'plan',last.meta.get('plan'),'left',last.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
 if last.stopped or last.done: raise RuntimeError('Stopped: '+str(last.meta))
 return last

def line(p,duration=1.,hold=.3,cameras=['practice_cam'],note=''):
 start=pose() if target is None else target.copy();p=np.array(p)
 n=max(1,int(round(duration/.05)));P=np.linspace(start,p,n+1)[1:]
 if hold:P=np.vstack([P,np.repeat(p[None],int(round(hold/.05)),axis=0)])
 for j in range(0,len(P),180):send(P[j:j+180],cameras=cameras,note=note)

def observe(name,cameras=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],depth=False):
 global last
 last=r.get_obs(cameras=cameras,depth=depth);last.save('/app/runs/'+name)
 for c,im in last.last.items():Image.fromarray(im).save('/app/runs/'+name+'/'+c+'.png')
 return last

if __name__=='__main__':
 done=set()
 print('READY',pose().tolist(),flush=True)
 while True:
  for f in sorted((ROOT/'commands').glob('*.py')):
   if f.name in done:continue
   done.add(f.name); print('COMMAND',f.name,flush=True)
   try:exec(compile(f.read_text(),str(f),'exec'),globals());(f.with_suffix('.done')).write_text('ok')
   except Exception:
    traceback.print_exc();(f.with_suffix('.error')).write_text(traceback.format_exc())
   print('FINISHED',f.name,flush=True)
  time.sleep(.2)
PY
